items.title: Quantitative Research Intern · Genk Capital
items.text: Derived a microstructure signal for price-level collapses in large-tick assets: a consistent 19-point lift in collapse persistence across every flow regime (40% to 59% in the tradable regime), over 106 days of Level-2 data. Survival analysis on 605K order-book updates put the median time-to-collapse at 97 ms, usable in real time. Modelled passive entries as three outcomes (fill, adverse selection, flat): positive expected value at every queue position after fees.
